name: Seychelles International Airport
notes: SCAA's NOTAM list of 01 OCT 2025 (https://www.scaa.sc/files/October%202025.pdf) gives the latest amendments as "AIRAC AIP Amendments: 02/25 WEF 12 JUNE 25" and "AIP Amendment: 02/25 WEF 1ST OCT 25", but these amended AD 2 FSIA pages are not on scaa.sc. The AIP file on scaa.sc (https://www.scaa.sc/files/AIP%20Seychelles.pdf, GEN pages 2017-2019) did not contain readable AD 2 FSIA text, and older FSIA amendment files (2010-2015) are superseded. Seychelles Airports Authority site (seychellesairports.sc) has no Mahé airport facts page found. Owner may need to request the current AIP AD 2 FSIA from SCAA AIS.
